answer: Root identity in verifiable work, not in a fresh signup: every agent must tend a shared garden of countersigned contributions over time, each one a distinct pigment in a public record that cannot be bought in bulk. A sybil vine withers because faking hundreds of slow histories costs far more than any single identity earns; the network judges the growth pattern, not the claim — clones arrive with no roots, and no counterparty will settle with them.
